title: Design System: The Ops Agent Book

display.purpose: Homepage title only; second line may be IBM Blue 60.

label.purpose: Sidebar groups, metadata labels, table headers.

mono.purpose: Code, identifiers, figure numbers, and stage labels only.

motion.name: control

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Square IBM blue action button for the main next step.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid var(--book-blue); border-radius: 0; background: var(--book-blue); color: var(--book-white); font: 500 13px/1 "IBM Plex Sans", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--book-blue-dark); border-color: var(--book-blue-dark); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--book-blue); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White, square button with a gray rule for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid var(--book-line-strong); border-radius: 0; background: var(--book-white); color: var(--book-ink); font: 500 13px/1 "IBM Plex Sans", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--book-ink); background: var(--book-gray-10); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--book-blue); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Muted text link; active state turns IBM blue and semibold without an underline.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 64px; color: var(--book-muted); font: 400 13px/1 "IBM Plex Sans", sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--book-ink); } .ds-nav-link--active { color: var(--book-blue); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--book-blue); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; background: var(--book-white); color: var(--book-body); font: 400 13px/1.58 "IBM Plex Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-table th { padding: 0.65rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--book-line); background: var(--book-gray-10); color: var(--book-muted); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-align: left; } .ds-table td { padding: 0.65rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--book-line); vertical-align: top; } .ds-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background: #fafafa; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: var(--book-blue-10); }

components.name: Diagram Figure

narrative.overview: The site is a technical publication, not a product landing page. It should read like an IBM engineering manual set on white paper: precise headings, thin gray rules, a calm reading column, and one confident blue that marks action and evidence. The world owns the frame, the masthead, the contents index, and the figure system; the prose column stays quiet and readable. The redesign removes the previous dark hero, warm paper ground, card grid, and eyebrow labels. What remains is a document-first system: a white page, IBM Plex type, square geometry, data tables, and numbered Mermaid diagrams. The diagram system is the signature: blue-stroked flowcharts, sequence diagrams, state machines, and timelines that explain the method in the same visual grammar across the book.
keyCharacteristics: White #ffffff ground with IBM Gray rules; no dark mode.
IBM Blue 60 #0f62fe is the only accent.
IBM Plex Sans for reading; IBM Plex Mono only for code, IDs, figure numbers, and stage labels.
Tables, index rows, and numbered diagrams instead of cards.
65–75ch body measure and generous section rhythm.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only accent. Do not introduce a second brand hue, gradient, or colored glow; emphasis comes from blue, weight, and scale.

rules.name: The Surface Rule
rules.body: The page ground is white. Gray 10 is a surface for data and annotations, never a page-wide background.

rules.name: The Reading Column Rule
rules.body: Running text stays at 65–75ch and 1.8 line-height. Never set body prose or headings in monospace.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Data Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for code, IDs, measurements, figure numbers, and stage labels. It is not a “technical” costume for labels or nav.

rules.name: The Rule-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: If a boundary is needed, draw a 1px rule. Never use a shadow to imply hierarchy.

dos: Do use IBM Plex Sans for reading and IBM Plex Mono only for code, IDs, figure numbers, and stage labels.
Do keep the page ground white and use Gray 10 only for data surfaces and annotations.
Do use IBM Blue 60 for action, links, active navigation, and diagram strokes; keep it rare enough to mean something.
Do use 1px gray rules to separate sections, rows, and metadata.
Do number every concept diagram and give it a caption plus surrounding text explanation.
Do keep the body measure at 65–75ch and section rhythm generous.
donts: Don't add a dark theme or a theme toggle; this world is forced light.
Don't use gradient text, glass, colored glows, or decorative shadows.
Don't use rounded cards, card grids, or nested cards for structure; use index rows and tables.
Don't put an eyebrow/kicker label above a heading; the heading carries its own weight.
Don't use a colored left border above 1px on cards, callouts, or list items.
Don't set running prose or headings in monospace.
Don't introduce a second accent color; blue is the only one.
